comparison.objective: Commission a damper, versus lift a scrap sheet from a laser bed while leaving cut parts behind.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate requires fine tool engagement, torque, collar adjustment, and iterative testing; record requires synchronized bimanual thin-edge pinching and level lifting to avoid dragging loose parts.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires two safe dynamic cycles without overload or drift. Record requires the sheet in the scrap bin and all four cut parts remaining on the bed without a fall.
comparison.reason: The sheet task tests coordinated large-object extraction and separation, not setting or commissioning an adjustable mechanism.
